verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API documents reading accounts, balances and transactions from a user's bank. However, nothing in the evidence shows an on-demand refresh endpoint or any documented refresh semantics such as cache behaviour, rate limits or consent requirements. Reading data is a related capability, not a triggered refresh, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented
